cases.claim: The private reshape capability and closed request normalizer remain outside every public facade.
Canonical normalization reproduces both accepted fixed SHA-256 vectors.
Object and set order normalize while semantic-element and final-description order remain meaning-bearing.
A split partitions one description exactly and transfers rows to a newly anchored Work atomically.
A merge moves all residual rows and typed references, removes the absorbed Work and order entry, and creates no tombstone.
Created and explicitly discarded semantic rows are structurally accounted without claiming natural-language novelty or wisdom.
Gaps, overlaps, mismatched fragments, duplicate positions, and incomplete affected relationship coverage fail closed.
Association, projection-link, dependency, and Window membership dispositions reconstruct one valid final candidate.
Dependency retain, rebind, represented, and no-longer-required paths validate final endpoints and reject self-dependency.
Read-only preflight returns exact source, normalized request, hash, candidate, decompositions, authority impact, and one opaque token without changing source.
The transient registry accepts at least 256 random bits, stores only token digests, enforces capacity, and expires records after 3600 seconds.
Apply preparation re-normalizes and re-audits exact request, hash, token, source, candidate, expiry, and replay bindings.
Token committing recovery returns exact old source to unused, exact candidate to consumed, and rejects a third digest.
A complete byte-identical request emits PTPOOL-117 and still has a consumable one-time token.
Unchanged residual wording with materialized references emits only the bounded PTPOOL-112 assistance unless explicitly acknowledged.
The apply preview marks the candidate-bound user-response boundary and required DAG owner without storing LLM self-review or changing the active public runtime.
